description: Export a DOM capture as JSON, saved to a file. `domId` comes from eyes_inspect_steps (baseline.domId or checkpoint.domId per step). Use to inspect exact computed styles/structure, or to locate an element's rect/id for use elsewhere (e.g. as an eyes_inspect_history nodeId). Returns a file path — pass it directly to the Read tool, or search it with eyes_inspect_dom_search rather than writing an ad-hoc script.

domId.description: Baseline or checkpoint domId from eyes_inspect_steps

rect.description: Optional crop/filter rectangle in pixels. Use image sizes from eyes_inspect_steps to construct it (e.g. top quarter of a 1020×600 image = {left:0,top:0,width:1020,height:150}). Don't pad it.

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present)

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_inspect_dom
